capabilities: answer questions about selected text as inline cards with follow-ups and hover popovers
grow a new linked child note from a question about a phrase
run background deep dives that write longer pages and mark them unread
browse the family of nested pages in a sidebar panel with unread and failed states
configure model context from vault search, web search, excluded folders and extra instructions
disambiguation: Not a reading-mode or annotation tool; it asks an AI about selected text and can grow the answer into child notes.
extras: Desktop only and requires Obsidian 1.13.0 or later. The plugin is free but answers cost money through the chosen AI service. Excluded-folder protection varies by connection: enforced by the plugin with an API key, best-effort with the Claude plan, and instruction-only with the codex sandbox, which can read the whole disk. No telemetry or ads.
intentEvidence: This is an Obsidian port of Nested Reader by True Frontier.
problem: Obsidian has no built-in way to ask an AI about a specific phrase in place and keep answers attached to the text or grow them into linked notes.
